section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因用PCR基因扩增仪，正面与背面均固定连接有固定杆，所述固定杆的底部固定连接有压板，所述样品架的两侧均设置有提手机构，所述提手机构包括外框，所述外框的顶部开设有隔热槽，且隔热槽的内壁固定连接有第一隔热层，所述外框的顶部铰接有隔热板，本实用新型涉及PCR基因扩增仪技术领域。该生物基因用PCR基因扩增仪，将样品架放置在扩增槽进行加热，加热时隔热槽中的第一隔热层和隔热板下的第二隔热层将热量隔绝在外框外部，手柄不易受热，加热完成后，打开盖板，压板随之向上移动，在第一弹簧的反作用力下，手柄向上弹出隔热槽，即可通过手柄将样品架取出扩增槽，操作方便，降低使用时的安全隐患。

The utility model discloses a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes, wherein fixed rods are fixedly connected to the front side and the back side of the PCR gene amplification instrument, pressing plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the fixed rods, lifting handle mechanisms are arranged on two sides of a sample rack, each lifting handle mechanism comprises an outer frame, a heat insulation groove is formed in the top of each outer frame, a first heat insulation layer is fixedly connected to the inner wall of each heat insulation groove, and a heat insulation plate is hinged to the top of each outer frame. This PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene places the sample frame and heats at the amplification groove, first insulating layer in the heat insulation groove and the second insulating layer under the heat insulation board during the heating completely cut off the heat outside the frame, the handle is difficult for being heated, after the heating is accomplished, open the apron, the clamp plate upwards moves thereupon, under the reaction force of first spring, the heat insulation groove is upwards popped out to the handle, can take out the amplification groove with the sample frame through the handle, high durability and convenient operation reduces the potential safety hazard during the use.

PCR gene amplification instrument for biological geneTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of PCR gene amplification instruments, in particular to a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes.

Background

The PCR amplifier is widely used in medical and biological laboratories, for example, for judging whether a sample shows a map of a certain genetic disease, diagnosis of infectious diseases, gene replication, paternity test, etc., the PCR amplifier generally consists of a heat cover component, a heat cycle component, a transmission component, a control component, a power supply component, etc., the principle of the PCR technology is similar to the natural replication process of DNA, the specificity of the PCR technology depends on oligonucleotide primers with complementary two ends of a target sequence, and the PCR amplifier consists of three basic reaction steps of denaturation-annealing-extension.

At present when placing the sample test tube and heating in the amplification groove, the temperature of sample test tube and sample frame can rise, and the amplification is accomplished the back, and too high temperature makes sample frame be difficult for taking out, scalds the hand easily, and carelessly breaks down the sample easily, has the potential safety hazard.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the utility model provides a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes, which solves the problems that the temperature of a sample test tube and a sample rack is increased during heating, the sample rack is difficult to take out and scald hands after amplification is finished due to overhigh temperature, the sample is easy to break carelessly, and potential safety hazards exist.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model is realized by the following technical scheme: the utility model provides a PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene, includes instrument body and sample frame, the front at instrument body top articulates there is the apron, and the equal fixedly connected with dead lever in front and the back of apron bottom both sides, the bottom fixedly connected with clamp plate of dead lever, the both sides of sample frame all are provided with handle mechanism.

The handle mechanism comprises a frame, a heat insulation groove is formed in the top of the frame, a first heat insulation layer is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the heat insulation groove, a heat insulation plate is hinged to the top of the frame, a second heat insulation layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the heat insulation plate, the heat insulation plate is located above the heat insulation groove, a first spring is fixedly connected to the front face and the back face of the bottom of the inner wall of the heat insulation groove, a movable plate is movably connected between the front face and the back face of the inner wall of the heat insulation groove, the bottom of the movable plate is fixedly connected with the top of the first spring, a handle is fixedly connected to the top of the movable plate, a limiting plate is fixedly connected to the front face and the top of the back face of the inner wall of the heat insulation groove, and the bottom of the pressing plate is movably connected with the top of the heat insulation plate.

Preferably, the sample frame comprises an upper frame body and a lower frame body, one side of the outer frame is fixedly connected with one side of the upper frame body, and the bottom of the upper frame body is fixedly connected with the top of the lower frame body through a vertical rod.

Preferably, a sample test tube penetrates through the upper frame body, and the bottom end of the sample test tube penetrates through the lower frame body and extends to the lower part of the lower frame body.

Preferably, the annular groove has been seted up to the inside of lower support body, and the inner wall fixedly connected with second spring of annular groove, the one end fixedly connected with that the annular groove inner wall was kept away from to the second spring encloses with the rubber of sample test tube looks adaptation.

Preferably, the front of the top of the instrument body is provided with an amplification groove, and the bottom of the inner wall of the amplification groove is fixedly connected with a heating plate.

Preferably, the two sides of the inner wall of the amplification tank are fixedly connected with heat conduction plates, and the sample rack is positioned between the two sides of the inner wall of the amplification tank.

Advantageous effects

The utility model provides a PCR gene amplification instrument for biological genes. Compared with the prior art, the method has the following beneficial effects:

(1) this PCR gene amplification instrument for biological gene, it has the apron to articulate through the front at instrument body top, and the front and the equal fixedly connected with dead lever in the back of apron bottom both sides, the bottom fixedly connected with clamp plate of dead lever, the both sides of sample frame all are provided with handle mechanism, place the sample frame and heat at the amplification groove, first insulating layer in the heat-insulating groove and the second insulating layer under the heat insulating board during heating completely cut off the heat outside the frame, the handle is difficult for being heated, after the heating is accomplished, open the apron, the clamp plate upwards removes thereupon, under the reaction force of first spring, the heat-insulating groove is upwards popped out to the handle, can take out the amplification groove with the sample frame through the handle, high durability and convenient operation, the potential safety hazard when reducing the use.

(2) This PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene has seted up the ring channel through the inside of lower support body, and the inner wall fixedly connected with second spring of ring channel, and the one end fixedly connected with of ring channel inner wall and the rubber circle of sample test tube looks adaptation are kept away from to the second spring, and sample test tube bottom is located the rubber circle, under the effort of second spring, stabilizes the sample test tube for the difficult production of sample test tube rocks during the removal.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-5, the present invention provides a technical solution: the utility model provides a PCR gene amplification appearance for biological gene, includes instrument body 1 and sample frame 2, and the front at instrument body 1 top articulates there is apron 3, and the front of 3 bottom both sides of apron and the equal fixedly connected with dead lever 4 in the back, the bottom fixedly connected with clamp plate 5 of dead lever 4, clamp plate 5 are located heat insulating board 64 directly over, and the both sides of sample frame 2 all are provided with handle mechanism 6.

The handle mechanism 6 comprises an outer frame 61, a heat insulation groove 62 is formed in the top of the outer frame 61, a first heat insulation layer 63 is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the heat insulation groove 62, the first heat insulation layer 63 is made of glass fiber materials and has good heat insulation performance, a heat insulation plate 64 is hinged to the top of the outer frame 61, a second heat insulation layer 65 is fixedly connected to the bottom of the heat insulation plate 64, the second heat insulation layer 65 is made of aerogel felt materials and prevents external heat from entering the heat insulation groove 62, the heat insulation plate 64 is located above the heat insulation groove 62, a first spring 66 is fixedly connected to the front side and the back side of the bottom of the inner wall of the heat insulation groove 62, the first spring 66 can be replaced to ensure elasticity, a movable plate 67 is movably connected between the front side and the back side of the inner wall of the heat insulation groove 62, the movable plate 67 can move up and down in the heat insulation groove 62, the bottom of the movable plate 67 is fixedly connected with the top end of the first spring 66, a handle 68 is fixedly connected to the top of the movable plate 67, lie in the heat-insulating groove 62 during the heating of handle 68, heat-proof quality is good, and is not easily heated, conveniently takes out sample holder 2 through handle 68, and the heat-insulating groove 62 inner wall openly and the equal fixedly connected with limiting plate 69 in top at the back, limiting plate 69 prevent that fly leaf 67 from shifting out the heat-insulating groove 62, the bottom of clamp plate 5 and the top swing joint of heat insulating board 64.

The sample frame 2 comprises an upper frame body 21 and a lower frame body 22, a plurality of holes matched with the sample test tubes 7 are formed in the tops of the upper frame body 21 and the lower frame body 22, one side of an outer frame 61 is fixedly connected with one side of the upper frame body 21, the bottom of the upper frame body 21 is fixedly connected with the top of the lower frame body 22 through a vertical rod, the sample test tubes 7 penetrate through the inside of the upper frame body 21, the bottom ends of the sample test tubes 7 penetrate through the lower frame body 22 and extend to the lower side of the lower frame body 22, the annular groove 8 is formed in the lower frame body 22, the inner wall of the annular groove 8 is fixedly connected with a second spring 9, one end, far away from the inner wall of the annular groove 8, of the second spring 9 is fixedly connected with a rubber ring 10 matched with the sample test tubes 7, the second spring 9 and the rubber ring 10 can be replaced, the elasticity is ensured, an amplification groove 11 is formed in the front surface of the top of the instrument body 1, and a heating plate 12 is fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner wall of the amplification groove 11, the both sides of amplification groove 11 inner wall all fixedly connected with heat-conducting plate 13, heat-conducting plate 13 evenly conducts the heat of hot plate 12 to amplification groove 11 in for amplification effect is good, and sample frame 2 is located between the both sides of amplification groove 11 inner wall, and the part that does not involve in the device all is the same with prior art or can adopt prior art to realize.

When the device is used, the sample rack 2 is placed in the amplification groove 11, the handle 68 is pressed into the heat insulation groove 62, the heat insulation plate 64 is sealed on the heat insulation groove 62, then the cover plate 3 is covered on the amplification groove 11, the fixing rod 4 and the pressing plate 5 below the cover plate 3 fix the heat insulation plate 64 on the heat insulation groove 62, the handle 68 is prevented from popping out, the first heat insulation layer 63 and the second heat insulation layer 65 isolate heat outside the outer frame 61 during heating, the handle is not easily heated, after heating is completed, the cover plate 3 is opened, the pressing plate 5 moves upwards, under the reaction force of the first spring 66, the handle 68 pops out the heat insulation groove 62 upwards, the limiting plate 69 limits the handle 68, the movable plate 67 is prevented from moving out of the heat insulation groove 62, the sample rack 2 is conveniently taken out of the amplification groove 11 through the exposed handle 68, when the sample test tube 7 is placed, the bottom of the test tube 7 sequentially penetrates through the rubber rings 10 of the upper rack body 21 and the lower rack body 22, under the reaction force of the second spring 9, the sample tube 7 is stabilized to prevent it from shaking.
